text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's overseas expedition was 
cancelled due to an injury caused by 
fatigue. Sirius Symboli is infuriated, 
believing it was brought about by 
arrogance and weakness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Sirius Symboli earned the right to 
challenge the world as an alternate, she 
seemed even stranger than before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seemed as though her obsession with 
Symboli Rudolf had grown so intense that 
it was beginning to swallow up even her 
original dream.
